test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words/phrase.

Fail to notice; ignore; condone (an offence etc.)
solution:
The correct answer is **"overlook".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The one-word substitute for fail to notice; ignore; condone is** ''overlook''.**
 
• The word 'overlook' means to fail to see or notice something.
 
• **Example: ***She never overlook at her previous mistakes.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

__
 
• **Overlong - **This is used to refer to something that is longer than usual.

 
 
• **Example:** *The new song is amazing but overlong.*
 
 
 
• **Overlie - **This means to lie on top of.
 
 
• **Example:** *She sleeps by overlying on her dad.*
 
 
 
• **Overly -** Means something excess.
 
 
• **Example:** *She is such an overly possessive woman.*
